decisions.decision: 006 keeps all THREE circle-input methods as selectable sub-modes (3-pt rim PRIMARY, 2-pt diameter, center-radius) rather than replacing center-radius
decisions.rationale: CONVENTIONS 'make the fork a toggle, not a decision' — let the human feel-test which precise-center method wins. 3-pt derives exact center via the shipped solveCircle so the 'exact center' worry dissolves.

decisions.decision: 008 type-it-exact uses widget style (i) — an editable dynamic-input pill at the cursor (canvas-rendered, no HTML overlay); Enter-with-buffer PLACES / Enter-empty FINISHES; passive path preserved byte-for-byte via inflightPoint() returning S.cursor verbatim when off/idle
decisions.rationale: User-chosen widget style; the Enter reconciliation avoids the finish-vs-place conflict (AutoCAD-style: Enter on empty line = finish). Passive-path invariant proven by object identity so the OFF experience is unchanged.
